title: (LEAD) Seoul stocks rebound over 2 pct on bargain hunting
caption:
South Korea’s main index jumped more than 2% after a steep drop, driven by cheap semiconductor stocks. Institutional investors led the buying, while foreign and retail sellers left. The rally shows a belief in a discount on Korean chips, but future earnings remain uncertain.
